value.option_title: MD verification inserted into Org-Mol's ester shortlist before synthesis
value.question: Does molecular-dynamics verification of viscosity and thermal conductivity reorder a machine-learning ester shortlist, or merely confirm it, and does the best coolant keep improving?
value.hypothesis: Molecular dynamics will reorder the shortlist because the machine-learning viscosity error (22.5% MAPE) exceeds MD's, so better esters appear only after verification.
held_fixed: protocol: 3 ns equilibration + 3 x 5 ns Green-Kubo production
cooling figure of merit = Mouromtseff number (turbulent-forced-convection exponents)

predictions.if_lever: By 100 candidates the replica ranking matches the sequential baseline and diverges from ML; the best figure keeps improving through 1000.
predictions.if_not: Replicas only match the sequential baseline by 300 candidates, and MD then merely confirms the ML ranking, unchanged from 100 through 1000.
predictions.decision_rule: At 300 candidates, call if_lever when the Spearman correlation between ML and MD cooling-figure ranks is below 0.7 and the best MD figure rises at least 5% from 100 to 300 candidates; otherwise if_not.
predictions.noise_rule: Per-candidate figure uncertainty is the standard error across its 3 replicas; bootstrap the Spearman correlation over candidates; rerun 10 candidates at 3x length with new seeds and require the ranking to be unchanged.
predictions.expected_why: The machine-learning model's 22.5% viscosity error is far larger than molecular dynamics' expected error, so verification must reshuffle the list.

value.compute_tested_why: Verifying more candidates is bought directly with more GPU-hours; the number of candidates is the axis, and wall-clock is compressed by running 8 candidates at once on the 8-GPU node.
value.scored_against: MD viscosity and thermal conductivity are compared with Org-Mol's measured values for Ester 1 (6.41 cSt, 0.141 W/m K) and Ester 2 (9.67 cSt, 0.138 W/m K); the best candidates' Mouromtseff number is compared with 3M Novec 649 (0.40 cSt, 0.059 W/m K). Never against the predictors.

Top candidates' Mouromtseff number is compared with 3M Novec 649 (0.40 cSt, 0.059 W/m K) to confirm competitiveness.
Spearman rank correlation between ML-predicted and MD-computed figures is bootstrapped over candidates and replicas.

phases.what: Extract the 461 Org-Mol monoesters, rank by ML figure, build ~20,000-atom boxes, assign OPLS-AA, energy-minimize (CPU only).
phases.stop_rule: stop when top-300 boxes are built or 4 CPU-hours elapse.

phases.what: Run Ester 1 and Ester 2 (5 replicas x 10 ns Green-Kubo) and benchmark real ns/day on the ~20,000-atom box.
phases.stop_rule: stop when both esters' viscosity standard error is under 15% or 2 wall-clock hours elapse.

phases.what: Run top-100 candidates (3 ns equilibration + 3 x 5 ns Green-Kubo) on the 8-GPU A100 node.

gate.else: stop: MD is no more accurate than the ML viscosity model, so verification adds nothing.

phases.what: Run candidates 101-300 on the 8-GPU A100 node.
phases.stop_rule: stop at 300 candidates done or when spend reaches budget_usd.

gate.else: throughput too low to afford 300 candidates in budget; run top-100 only and stop.

phases.stop_rule: stop at 1000 candidates or budget exhausted.

gate.else: the best figure already plateaued at 300 candidates; the 1000-candidate run is not justified.

restructuring.sequential_part: Each candidate's viscosity waits on one long trajectory; the ranking waits on 100, 300, then 1000 candidates.
restructuring.method: Run each candidate as parallel short replicas on separate GPUs and block-average the Green-Kubo integrals, so wall-clock shrinks by the replica count.
restructuring.condition: Independent replicas must sample the same equilibrium liquid, so block-average uncertainty falls as 1/sqrt(replicas); cheap check: viscosity from 3 versus 6 replicas on the anchor esters must agree within the standard error.
restructuring.baseline_sequential: One 45 ns trajectory per candidate on a single A100 (three 15 ns segments concatenated, same total sampling), tuned with gmx mdrun -nb gpu -pme gpu -bonded gpu -update gpu -ntmpi 1; timed in the anchor phase.
restructuring.baseline_copies: Independent 5 ns replica runs of the same candidate side by side on separate GPUs of the 8-GPU node; also timed in the anchor phase.

scope_gap: the 1000-candidate run and 100 ns-per-candidate sampling exceed the $1,000 budget
no synthesis, dielectric-constant, flammability, material-compatibility, or long-term-stability testing

novelty.closest_prior: Org-Mol screened 461 monoester cooling candidates with a transformer and measured only two by synthesis; none were molecular-dynamics-verified for viscosity or thermal conductivity [s1].
novelty.left_open: No published work runs Green-Kubo viscosity and thermal conductivity over a 100-to-1000 candidate ester shortlist, so whether MD reorders the ML ranking is untested.

limits: Shows single-phase ranking only, under one force field and 15 ns sampling; no synthesis, dielectric, flammability, compatibility, or stability checks.
value.test_summary: Rent an 8-GPU A100 node; run OPLS-AA Green-Kubo viscosity and thermal conductivity for the top 100 then 300 of Org-Mol's 461 monoesters; compare ML-vs-MD rank correlation and whether the best cooling figure keeps climbing; time a 45 ns single-trajectory baseline against parallel 5 ns replicas.
